warnings.title: App-side preview lifecycle (update_preview / disarm_preview / U-key wiring) still has zero automated coverage
warnings.evidence: update_preview :: proc(app: ^App) { if !app.preview_active { return } ... if app.preview_gen == app.state.topology.gen && app.preview_pipe == pipe && app.preview_to_tier == to { return } ... }
warnings.detail: B1's blocker terms are met (panel render + aggregation + next-tier decision now pinned and biting), but update_preview's own logic — gen-freshness memoization, the five disarm conditions, buffer ownership — runs only in the untested app; the harness reimplements arming (harness/run.odin:271) and bypasses app/main.odin, so a stale-preview or leak regression there passes CI.
warnings.recommended_fix: Extract update_preview's should-recompute/should-disarm decision into a pure core proc with @(test) pins (the forecast_summarize/preview_next_tier pattern), leaving app code a thin call.

notes.title: forecast_preview.dem header mislabels capture times, weather state, and a merge target
notes.evidence: #   1300ms — preview 1 -> wide: ... # card; weather shows NOW. ... -> "2 routes consolidate on node 1" + ... ; run 33500ms / capture at 30000ms
notes.detail: The header's first bullet says 1300ms (captures are 30000-33000ms); claims 'weather shows NOW' at 31000ms (surge starts tick 1200, run ends 670 — only the countdown is live); and labels the merge target node 1 where the blessed text names node 5 (verified by pair-derivation: (res2,host2)+(host2,res2) consolidate on r1 = node 5).
notes.recommended_fix: Fix the header bullets: 30000ms for the first, 'weather shows the surge countdown', and '2 routes consolidate on node 5'.

notes.title: harness save mode swallows preview-capture failures (returns true without checking fails)
notes.evidence: if save { write_manifest(...) write_file(log_path(name), ...) fmt.printf("  save ...") return true }
notes.detail: A failed preview directive appends to fails and skips write_golden, but the save branch returns true without checking fails — a bless silently misses a capture golden. Bounded: the next `harness run` fails on 'T2: no golden' (check_golden), so CI catches it post-bless.
notes.recommended_fix: Check len(fails)==0 before the save-branch return (or print fails), matching run mode's loud-failure contract.

notes.title: Preview directives authored out of time order silently arm the wrong preview (last-in-list wins)
notes.evidence: preview_event_index :: proc(events: []Preview_Intent, cap_ms: i64) -> int { best := -1; for i in 0..<len(events) { if events[i].at_ms <= cap_ms { best = i } } return best }
notes.detail: Selection is the last LIST position matching at_ms <= cap_ms, not the maximum at_ms. The parser accepts any order; a mis-ordered demo silently renders a different prediction and `harness save` would bless it.
notes.recommended_fix: Track the event with the maximum at_ms among matches, or reject non-ascending preview directives at parse time.

notes.title: preview demo verb truncates u64 pipe ids to u32 without a range check
notes.evidence: fid, okid := strconv.parse_uint(fields[3], 10) ... append(&d.preview_events, Preview_Intent{at_ms = ms, pipe = u32(fid), ...})
notes.detail: parse_uint returns u64; u32(fid) silently truncates an oversized id, which could name a different pipe and bless a mislabeled card. Extends the identical pre-existing pattern in draw/spawn/demolish/emphasis/lane — consistent but unchecked.
notes.recommended_fix: Reject ids > max(u32) in the preview verb's parse (and ideally the sibling verbs).

notes.title: Upgrade-preview recompute runs two full Dijkstra rebuilds inside the render pass
notes.evidence: update_preview(app) — called from draw_hud inside BeginDrawing/EndDrawing; forecast_shift builds before+after Routing_Tables.
notes.detail: Memoized per (gen, pipe, tier), so the rebuilds run only when inputs change — but sim-scale compute sits in the draw path; a late-game map could hitch a frame on the recompute tick.
notes.recommended_fix: Trigger the recompute at the observable edit moments and keep draw_hud render-only, or note the scale budget explicitly.
